description: Scenario list page with status filters, customer/title search, pricing columns, and navigation to scenario creation and details.
notes: Owner clarification 2026-06-03: scenario-list-page owns ONLY the /scenarios list route, navigation entry, status filters, customer/title search, pricing columns, target margin, risk count display, updated date, empty state, and responsive readability.

It EXCLUDES the /scenarios/new create and /scenarios/:id edit/detail workflows, which are owned by scenario-editor. scenario-list-page may link to those routes only when they exist; otherwise actions should stay non-broken and clearly routed to the current list workflow.
Part 10 smoke remediation on 2026-06-02 added the minimal /scenarios list page and navigation path wired to the existing scenario API.
spec:
1. Add /scenarios list route and navigation entry.
2. Show status filters for draft, review, approved, and archived.
3. Support customer and title search.
4. Show pricing columns including final price and margin — use Intl.NumberFormat for all percentage formatting via the shared formatPercent() helper from frontend/src/lib/pricingFormatters.ts. Do NOT use inline `.toFixed(N)%` patterns.
5. Show target margin, risk count, and updated date columns.
6. Include an empty state for the list workflow.
7. Keep list text readable at mobile and desktop widths.
8. Exclude /scenarios/new create and /scenarios/:id edit/detail workflows; those are owned by scenario-editor. scenario-list-page may link to those routes only when they exist, otherwise actions must stay non-broken and clearly routed to the current list workflow.
title: Scenario List Page
